# has name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasName`](gmeow-hasName.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasName>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

Relates a person to a structured, typed [`PersonName`](../classes/gmeow-PersonName.md) they bear; the person-scoped specialization of [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md). Non-functional — a person bears many co-equal names.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md) -> [`gmeow:PersonName`](../classes/gmeow-PersonName.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a direct, co-equal person-to-PersonName bearing where audience, register, evidence, and context do not need their own node.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using this as a display winner, legal-name shortcut, or provenance-bearing assertion; use [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) or statement metadata when period, authority, audience, or suppression must be explicit.

### How to use

- Assert one [`hasName`](gmeow-hasName.md) triple per co-equal [`PersonName`](../classes/gmeow-PersonName.md); carry validity, displayable false, source, or confidence on the statement layer, or promote to [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) when the bearing itself must be a relator.

### Examples

- ex:patrick a [`gmeow:Person`](../classes/gmeow-Person.md); [`gmeow:hasName`](gmeow-hasName.md) ex:patrickLatinName, ex:patrickHanName.
